title: Family Vietnam in 10 days
summary: Hanoi, Ha Long, Da Nang, and Hoi An.

days.title: Day 1 — Hanoi
days.body: Land and walk Hoan Kiem Lake.

days.title: Day 2 — Ethnology
days.body: The ethnology museum. An adult ticket is 40,000 VND.

days.title: Day 3 — Water puppets
days.body: The water puppets. The fee is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 4 — Ha Long
days.body: Sun World if you want the cable. Hours and prices sit on that page.

days.title: Day 6 — Ba Na
days.body: Ba Na is a full day. A non-resident adult is 1,000,000 VND.

days.title: Day 7 — My Khe
days.body: My Khe is half a day and free to swim.

days.title: Day 8 — Beach sports
days.body: Beach sports are a couple of hours. The fee is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 9 — Hoi An
days.body: The folk-culture museum is a museum hour. From 10 August 2026 the city fee is 20,000 VND per person per building.

days.title: Day 10 — Leave Da Nang
days.body: Keep the morning in Hoi An.

seoDescription: Hanoi, Ha Long, Da Nang, and Hoi An in ten days, with the ethnology museum, Ba Na, and My Khe.
